name: Budou Academy
description: Budou Academy — a sommelier school theme for people who already work in service. A white ground and warm panel (#F3EEE6), vine-green gradient type (#4A6358 to #82997A) and a wine accent (#6E2A3A). The home page opens on an interlocking collage of four rounded photographs (54 px) under one huge slanted Cormorant Garamond headline that crosses the seam between them, a floating white pill header with three programme tabs and solid tile buttons, and a next-term bar. It continues with a wash About section, the shape of a Monday as a horizontal time rail on a rounded panel, three saturated bands with one 90 px corner, translucent arcs and a photograph across the band edge, programme cards, a full-width fee table, faculty, alumni and a mirrored sit-in band. Cormorant Garamond for headings, Source Sans 3 for reading. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; scroll effects respect reduced motion.

summary.en: A sommelier school: an interlocking photo-tile hero with a slanted gradient headline, a floating pill header, a Monday time rail and green bands with photos across the edge.
summary.fr: Une école de sommellerie : collage de photos arrondies avec un grand titre italique en dégradé, en-tête flottant, frise d'un lundi et bandes vertes dont la photo déborde.
summary.de: Eine Sommelierschule: Foto-Collage mit schrägem Verlaufstitel, schwebender Kopfzeile, Montags-Zeitleiste und grünen Bändern mit überlappendem Foto.
